Conviction has decreased to 4.0 due to the conflicting signals and increased uncertainty from legal and regulatory pressures. T: Risk has increased to 6.9. The persistent bearish MACD recovery, combined with the substantial legal and regulatory risks highlighted in the news, significantly elevates downside exposure. The stressed balance sheet and negative FCF remain structural concerns, now compounded by these new, significant liabilities. The previous risk score of 6.8 is adjusted upwards due to the magnitude of the new legal and regulatory risks.
